rules: All original candidates for all3 fixed proposal models; no subgroup or ticker selection, new trade/outcome or threshold fitting. Same week/models remain correlated, KILL unchanged.
Reproduce all original model metrics/stress/portfolios and original report/source checksums before audit. Preserve all OPEN,AMBIGUOUS,DATA_GAP and unfilled records.
Only unsigned public settlement history; no account Funding, credentials, signed requests, real orders or live state changes. Funding is hypothetical, not actual cash flow.

Query original fixed week with24h prefix and endpoint at original cutoff inclusive; no later outcome interval or sealed week. Store exclusive raw pages/manifest and hashes, never overwrite or regenerate favorable results.

Pagination must exhaust without repeated cursor/duplicate timestamp; require true isSettlement, matching contractId, fundingTime==fundingTimestamp, finite rate/positive indexPrice, integer positive funding interval. IndexPrice is used per official Funding documentation; no LAST_PRICE/Oracle substitution.

Coverage requires a uniform historical interval on UTC-aligned settlements, complete expected grid spanning original period including any cutoff settlement. Variable interval,missing,pagination,error,invalid data block valuation, never zero-fill.

Original OHLC fills may occur anywhere in [filled_ms,filled_ms+15m); exits in [outcome_ms-15m,outcome_ms]. Funding inside either boundary is TIMING_AMBIGUOUS, including exit endpoints. Certain-held settlements lie in [fill+15m,exitbarstart). No boundary order assumption.

LONG charge=quantity*indexPrice*rate, SHORT negates; report per-unit/R on original frozen net stop-risk. Receipts are negative costs. Only original TP/SL records with complete coverage and no boundary settlement can have fully determined hypothetical Funding charge.

Full resolved-basket adjusted AvgR/PF/netwin only if EVERY original resolved trade has verified funding coverage and no timing ambiguity; otherwise null, not selected-subset success. Core known-held charge is a partial diagnostic, not full Funding or adjusted expectancy.

No capital ROI recomputation, risk resizing, funding-aware fill/rule changes or original metric modification. Funding can affect actual available collateral; static cost subtraction is not a capital simulation. ROI remains unknown.
No additional samples, forward promotion, notifications, UI/tabs or production deployment. No KILL revival or active protocol changes; original decisions and untouched periods remain sealed.
